name: fsp-quest-create-after-profile-complete
description: B1 regression: profile fields complete in an early turn, goal + habits land in a later turn of the same conversation. season_start (main_quest bundled in, per B3) and quest_create must still fire once the goal is stated. Only meaningful with A1 landed underneath this PR in the stack - turn 1's profile_update has to actually persist (ordinary-turn writes no longer discarded) for isAthleteProfileComplete to flip true before turn 2 runs. Placeholder removal (this PR) means the completion gate isFirstSessionRitualDone can no longer be fooled by a seeded main_quest, so the ritual genuinely stays open into turn 2. NOTE: this harness calls askGemini() with soul: "" (see this file's header comment), so it exercises the response schema and coachPromptText.ts logic only, not SOUL prompt wording.
